page_title: RSO 1-2 RMA | Real Sociedad v Real Madrid 13/09/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+6' Arsen Zakharyan (Real Sociedad) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Jesus Manzano no option but to blow his whistle.
90+3' Jon Karrikaburu (Real Sociedad) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
90+2' The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Jon Aramburu (Real Sociedad). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate.
90' 6 additional min. will be played.
90' Dangerous play by Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad). Jesus Manzano blows his whistle for a foul.
89' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) latches on to a precise pass on the edge of the box, but miskicks his shot and the ball goes high over the bar. Poor effort!

88' Duje Caleta-Car (Real Sociedad) outjumps the defence to meet the resulting corner and heads the ball towards the middle of the goal. The long-range header is not powerful enough, and the keeper comfortably makes a save.
88' Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad) prepares to take a corner kick.
88' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and David Alaba (Real Madrid) is coming onto the pitch as Arda Guler cannot continue after picking up an injury.
84' Real Sociedad will take a corner kick.
84' Jon Karrikaburu (Real Sociedad) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared.
82' Xabi Alonso prepares a substitution. Daniel Carvajal is replaced by Trent Alexander-Arnold (Real Madrid).
82' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box.
79' Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box after picking up a pass, but produces a poor effort that sails high over the bar.

78' Raul Asencio (Real Madrid) leaps highest in the penalty area to get on the end of a cross from the set piece, and he produces a promising goal-bound header towards the roof of the net, but Alex Remiro pulls off a decent save to deny him.
78' Substitution. Jon Gorrotxategi walks off the pitch and Jon Karrikaburu (Real Sociedad) comes on as a substitute.
77' Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
75' Real Sociedad failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
72' This shall not pass! Arsen Zakharyan (Real Sociedad) lines up a shot from the edge of the box and goes for goal, but the effort is well blocked by a defender.
72' Real Sociedad force their opponents to concede a corner.
69' Substitution. Dani Ceballos is replaced by Raul Asencio (Real Madrid).
68' That will be all from Vinicius Junior who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Fran Garcia (Real Madrid).
67' Duje Caleta-Car (Real Sociedad) is first to the rebound inside the box but sends his effort high over the bar.
66' Sergio Francisco has decided to make a change. Arsen Zakharyan (Real Sociedad) replaces Goncalo Guedes.
66' Substitution. Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) replaces Pablo Marin.
65' Real Sociedad have been awarded a corner kick.
65' Half-chance! Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) plays a pass into the box, but Thibaut Courtois reacts well to snuff out the attack.
63' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
63' The expression of the referee Jesus Manzano is crystal clear. This behaviour won't be tolerated. Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) is shown a yellow card.
61' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
60' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) finds some space on the edge of the box after some nice individual play and curls a shot in on goal, but the ball flies just wide of the left post.
58' The game is interrupted as Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) is flagged offside.
57' Sergio Francisco decides to make a substitution. Mikel Goti Lopez will be replaced by Carlos Soler (Real Sociedad).
57' It will be a substitution. Jon Aramburu (Real Sociedad) is ready to enter the pitch as Aritz Elustondo walks off.
56' 1 - 2 Goal! Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Thibaut Courtois into the bottom right corner.
55' Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
54' Daniel Carvajal (Real Madrid) touches the ball with his hand inside the box! The advantage of a penalty kick is given to Real Sociedad.
53' Real Sociedad win a corner.
52' Jesus Manzano has a clear sight and sees a foul from Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid).
51' Pablo Marin (Real Sociedad) receives a lofted pass from the side and shoots from around the penalty spot, but the ball flies onto the right post!

50' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) shows off his amazing technique to get to the edge of the box by himself. He pulls the trigger but sends the ball miles wide of the right post. Nice run, but poor finish!
48' A spell of possession for Real Sociedad in an attempt to control the game.
46' Xabi Alonso has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Federico Valverde comes on the pitch for Brahim Diaz (Real Madrid).
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+4' Jesus Manzano has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+3' Aritz Elustondo (Real Sociedad) makes an unfair challenge by holding his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball.
45+2' Real Sociedad take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
45+1' Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) was probably a bit loose with his words to Jesus Manzano, who decides to show him a yellow.
45' We will have 4 min. of added time.
44' 0 - 2 Goal! Arda Guler (Real Madrid) finds himself some space inside the box to get on the end of a pass from Kylian Mbappe, then sends the ball inside the right post. 0:2.
42' Igor Zubeldia (Real Sociedad) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Jesus Manzano blows his whistle for a foul.
41' Aritz Elustondo (Real Sociedad) fouls an opponent during an attacking move.
40' Poor challenge! Aurelien Tchouameni (Real Madrid) is penalised for tripping and Jesus Manzano blows his whistle.
40' Eder Militao (Real Madrid) produces an effort from the edge of the box, but doesn't hit the ball properly and sends it yards wide of the right post.
39' Mikel Goti Lopez (Real Sociedad) is penalised after knocking an opponent down.
37' Mikel Goti Lopez (Real Sociedad) commits a rough foul. Jesus Manzano stops the game and makes a call.
36' Good work from Real Sociedad as they win a corner.
35' That's unlucky! Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared.
34' Real Sociedad take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
34' Referee Jesus Manzano halts the game and wanders over to the touchline to talk to Xabi Alonso, then shows him a yellow.
32' A strict call by Jesus Manzano! He pulls out the red card and sends Dean Huijsen (Real Madrid) off the pitch.
31' Arda Guler (Real Madrid) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
31' A quickly taken corner by Real Madrid.

30' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) received a pass inside the box and sent a dangerous shot in on goal, but keep the champagne on ice as one of the defenders stepped in and blocked the effort. It's hard to say whether the keeper would have stopped it.

30' Eder Militao (Real Madrid) jumps inside the box to meet the resulting corner and steers his header into the roof of the net, but the goalkeeper pulls off an astonishing save to deny him. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Real Madrid.
30' Now Real Madrid have a corner.
27' The corner kick picks out Dean Huijsen (Real Madrid) free in the box, but his header from close in lacks control and balloons high over the bar.
27' Real Madrid will have a chance to score from a corner kick.

26' Eder Militao (Real Madrid) creates himself some space inside the goalmouth and connects with the resulting free kick. His accurate header would have probably ended up inside the left post, but Alex Remiro pulls off a superb reflex save to thwart him.
25' Aritz Elustondo (Real Sociedad) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Jesus Manzano blows his whistle for a foul.
25' Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
23' Real Sociedad quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

22' Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) attempts to find one of his teammates with a sweet pass into the box, but one of the defending players reacts well and intercepts the effort. The linesman makes the right call and Real Sociedad will have a corner.
21' Mikel Goti Lopez (Real Sociedad) gets on the end of a pass and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players.
19' Pablo Marin (Real Sociedad) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Jesus Manzano blows for a foul.
18' An accurate pass to the edge of the box is well taken by Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad), whose instinctive shot towards goal flashes inches wide of the left post.
17' Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
15' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) expertly controls a neat clever pass inside the box, but his effort crashes against the right post! What an opportunity that was!
12' 0 - 1 GOAL! Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) gets to the ball on the edge of the box after a huge mistake by an opponent and slams it into the back of the net. He makes it 0:1.
10' Aurelien Tchouameni (Real Madrid) sends a cross into the box, but Alex Remiro comes off his line to gather the ball.
9' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) latches onto a cross inside the box and aims a shot towards the middle of the goal, but Alex Remiro reacts superbly to deny him.
6' Jesus Manzano shows a yellow card to Igor Zubeldia (Real Sociedad), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
5' Real Sociedad can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
3' The goal by Real Madrid is DISALLOWED on the advice of the video assistant referee due to an offside.
2' The Real Madrid players halt their celebrations as referee Jesus Manzano makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
2' Arda Guler (Real Madrid) accepts a sweet pass and produces a perfect strike from the edge of the box that goes inside the left post and past the helpless goalkeeper.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Real Sociedad will kick-off.
Jesus Manzano will officiate today.
